data.name: MOD0001_Title
data.value: A module must not expose public types

data.name: MOD0001_Message
data.value: Type '{0}' is public in a module assembly

data.name: MOD0001_Description
data.value: A module's types are an implementation detail, and the rule that keeps the host free of module references depends on that. Make it internal, or move it to a contracts library. Controllers, page models, view components, tag helpers and configured entity types are exempt; anything else goes in modulith_allowed_public_types.

data.name: MOD0002_Title
data.value: The type named by HostingStartup must be a module

data.name: MOD0002_Message
data.value: Type '{0}' is named by [assembly: HostingStartup] but does not derive from '{1}'

data.name: MOD0002_Description
data.value: ASP.NET Core instantiates this type and casts it to IHostingStartup. Deriving from ModuleBase is also what registers the module and checks that the modules it references were activated.

data.name: MOD0003_Title
data.value: The host must not use types from a module

data.name: MOD0003_Message
data.value: The host uses types from module assembly '{0}'

data.name: MOD0003_Description
data.value: A project reference is fine — it orders the build and copies the module to the output. Using the module's types is not: it puts that module in every deployment. Move the shared type to a contracts assembly.

data.name: MOD0004_Title
data.value: The host must not declare an ApplicationPart for a module

data.name: MOD0004_Message
data.value: The host declares [assembly: ApplicationPart] for module assembly '{0}'

data.name: MOD0004_Description
data.value: Application Part Discovery does not know about HostingStartup: it loads a module's controllers and pages without running the module. Set GenerateMvcApplicationPartsAssemblyAttributes to false and let each module call AddApplicationPart.

data.name: MOD0005_Title
data.value: A module must be named by an assembly-level HostingStartup attribute

data.name: MOD0005_Message
data.value: Module '{0}' is never named by an [assembly: HostingStartup] attribute and will not be loaded

data.name: MOD0005_Description
data.value: Without the attribute the module fails silently: ASP.NET Core loads the assembly, finds no attribute and moves on, so the module's services and endpoints do not exist and nothing is logged.

data.name: MOD0006_Title
data.value: A module must not replace the application pipeline

data.name: MOD0006_Message
data.value: '{0}' replaces the whole request pipeline and must not be called from a module

data.name: MOD0006_Description
data.value: IWebHostBuilder.Configure and UseStartup define the pipeline rather than adding to it, discarding whatever the host and every other module set up. Override ModuleBase.Configure instead.

data.name: MOD0007_Title
data.value: Redundant IStartupFilter registration

data.name: MOD0007_Message
data.value: '{0}' already registers itself as an IStartupFilter

data.name: MOD0007_Description
data.value: ModuleBase already registers the module as an IStartupFilter. Registering it again runs Configure twice, duplicating every piece of middleware and every endpoint the module adds.

data.name: MOD0008_Title
data.value: A hosted service in a module runs in every replica that loads it

data.name: MOD0008_Message
data.value: Module '{0}' registers a hosted service, which will run once per replica of every topology that loads this module

data.name: MOD0008_Description
data.value: A worker that ran in one replica of one service now runs wherever its module is loaded, and twice if two replicas load it. Choose: leader election, a dedicated worker topology, or once per replica — then suppress.

data.name: MOD0020_Title
data.value: The Modulith package is not referenced

data.name: MOD0020_Message
data.value: This assembly declares a HostingStartup but does not reference '{0}', so module rules cannot be verified

data.name: MOD0020_Description
data.value: The runtime package is missing, so ModuleBase cannot be found and the rules that depend on it are inactive. The build is green because nothing is being checked.
